confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for a July 2026 peak-season window, not from live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately confident; hostel and hotel anchors are least certain because summer coastal accommodation rates are volatile and seasonal. The FX observation comes from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA exchange rates overview page; I did not open that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is general knowledge of southern Albanian Ionian coastal resort towns (such as Ksamil, Vlore and Durres) and Albania's price levels, adjusted upward for July resort demand. Beer and coffee are benchmarked to Albanian urban and coastal venue pricing. Cocktail and wine are set relative to beer, as direct knowledge is weaker.
